objectives: 介紹統計推論之概念及理論。在第一學期 (統計推論 I) 將會介紹機率論相關的知識，以供第二學期 (統計推論 II) 詳細介紹統計推論的理論知識。
content: Probability and distributions, Properties of random sample, Principles of data reduction, Point estimation, Hypothesis testing, Interval estimation, and Asymptotic evaluations.
books: G Casella and RL Berger (2002). Statistical Inference (2nd Ed). Duxbury Advanced Series.
